data-size.description: Compact padding for dense grids such as resource cards and statistics (since 2.0.9).

classes.blora-card: Surface container. Nest at most one level (use data-variant="inset" for the inner surface); organise content inside with lists, descriptions and dividers instead of more cards.
classes.blora-card__header: Header row (since 2.0.9): title block on the start side, status or actions on the end side.
classes.blora-card__desc: Muted one-line description under the title (since 2.0.9).
classes.blora-card__foot: Footer separated by a top border, usually a .blora-actions row.
classes.blora-card__badge: Absolutely positioned corner badge; requires data-positioned on the card.
classes.blora-panel: Looser, larger container for page sections.
classes.blora-panel__header: Panel header row with a bottom border.
